parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger
Daily 09:00 Asia/Manila, the Manual button, or a key-protected webhook for tests (can override review/publish mode).

**Config** holds every switch: `review_mode` auto|approval, `publish_mode` simulation|live, page id, models, rotation.

## 2. Extract (polite)
robots.txt first, every URL checked against it. One request at a time, >= Crawl-delay (3 s) apart, plain bot User-Agent.
Sitemap of today's content type (Mon article, Tue package, Wed Q&A, Thu article, Fri news, Sat package, Sun Q&A) -> newest URL not in **pw_posted_urls** -> page -> title, summary, body, og:image.
If PlacidWay answers 403 (Cloudflare blocks datacenter IPs), it reads the Internet Archive copy instead and logs that.

## 3. Generate + guardrails
Haiku writes JSON (hook, 2-4 lines, CTA, hashtags); code adds the link, so the URL can never be invented.
Guardrail 1: rules (length, structure, banned claim words, every number/price must exist in the source).
Guardrail 2: Sonnet reads draft vs source as a compliance reviewer.
Both must pass. One rewrite with the issues as feedback, then block + alert.

## 4. Review option + publish
`review_mode = approval`: draft goes to Discord with Approve / Reject links that resume this run (Wait node, 24 h limit, bots ignored).
`publish_mode = simulation` logs the exact Graph API request; `live` posts to the TEST page (photo post when an image exists, else link post). Optional scheduling.

## 5. Log + notify
One exit for every outcome. Row in **pw_run_log** (item, post text, checks, FB post id, status), URL remembered in **pw_posted_urls**, one Discord line.

## Failures never pass silently
Site, LLM and Discord nodes retry (HTTP: 3 tries, 5 s apart; site fetch: only 429/5xx/network, growing backoff) then route their **error output** here. Facebook publish is a non-idempotent POST: no retry on 4xx, one retry only on network error/5xx. The Error Trigger catches anything else. -> alert in Discord + failure row in the log.

## Stretch: dashboard
GET /webhook/placidway-assessment/dashboard?k=KEY renders the run log as an HTML table. Wrong or missing key = 401.
